authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 1095 identifies Hindi mūṅg-phalī groundnut; the Hindi Saraiyya survey records muŋphali (kannauji p. 72). The whole matching compound is linked to that existing Hindi attestation as a provisional regional borrowing route. The attestation village is not asserted to be the historical donor locality; intermediate Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Both components of the Hindi donor are linked in this same pass. Survey compound: mumpʰʌli.
